entities.summary: Lekhanya, a notable figure in the history of Lesotho, associated with Military Rule and Democratic Transition (1986–1993). Preceded by Military Junta 1986–1993. Their legacy influenced SADC Intervention Lesotho 1998 and 1993 Democratic Elections.
